# [Fix] session: Keep recurrent state aligned with kept tokens

## Motivation

A streaming session keeps a finished turn's KV row and, on hybrid models, its live Mamba/GDN state for the next turn. The kept state can cover more tokens than the session keeps, in three ways:

1. **Overshoot.** A speculative verify commits KV and recurrent state for its whole accepted run, which can pass `max_new_tokens` or a stop token. `_trim_overshoot` (#22897) cuts KV and `output_ids` back but cannot rewind the state.
2. **Bonus end.** When the run ends exactly at the limit, no forward has computed the last (bonus) token, yet the slot commits it.
3. **Rerun of a finished turn.** The overlap loop launches the next batch before it processes the result that finishes a turn, so the turn runs once more and that forward advances the kept state. #42720 drops such a request only when its next single token reaches `max_new_tokens`, so this affects speculative turns and any turn that ends on EOS or a stop token, with or without speculation.

Example: `Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base`, `--speculative-algorithm NGRAM --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --enable-streaming-session --page-size 1`. Turn 1 has a 16-token prompt and `max_new_tokens: 6`. The last verify reaches 9 output tokens, so the session keeps 22 tokens while the state absorbed 24, and turn 2's first token differs from a fresh request with the same `input_ids` by 0.41 in logprob. Without speculation, a turn ending on a stop token keeps state one token ahead.

Duplicate-work check: I searched open and closed issues and PRs for streaming sessions with speculative decoding, hybrid or Mamba models, overshoot, `_trim_overshoot` and in-flight finishes. #22897 trims paged KV only, #42330 added the release path reused here, and #42720 covers the one-token in-flight length case. None covers the recurrent state.

## Modifications

- `_trim_overshoot` keeps at most the request clock (`kv_committed_len`), which counts only computed tokens. A turn ending on a bonus token keeps one token less, and the next turn prefills it.
- When the overlap loop processes a result, it marks each request that a launched or planned batch already runs again (`Req.relaunched_in_flight`). It does this only with streaming sessions on a hybrid model.
- `try_cache_finished_req`: if the record holds recurrent state that absorbed tokens past the visible output, or the turn is marked as rerun, the session returns the record through the normal release path (#42330). The turn stays in the session history, and the next turn re-prefills from the radix cache, starting at its last Mamba checkpoint (every 64 tokens in these runs).
- Processing the pending result before planning would also prevent the rerun, but it drops planning overlap for every step of such a batch. In the benchmark below that halves throughput with 64-token turns, so this PR releases the record instead.
- Tests: `test_scheduler_session_relaunch_mark.py` drives `event_loop_overlap` and checks the mark for an overlapped rerun, a synchronous step with a planned rerun, no rerun, and the feature gates. `test_streaming_session_unit.py` adds the trim, release and rerun cases.

## Accuracy Tests

```bash
python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_session_relaunch_mark.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_streaming_session_unit.py
```

| Tests | main | this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| New and changed session and scheduler tests | fail: the record is kept and no request is marked | all pass |
| `managers` plus the Mamba and session suites | 1,095 passed | 1,105 passed |

The suites show the same failures on both trees: two multimodal feature-pool tests and one module that needs the missing `parameterized` package.

End to end: 12 two-turn sessions per configuration after NGRAM warm-up. An observation-only probe compares each kept length with the tokens its recurrent state absorbed, and turn 2 is compared with a fresh request on the same full history. Length-ended turns use `max_new_tokens` 5 to 16, and stop-ended turns end on `,` or `.` (`stop_token_ids`). The Mamba strategy is `extra_buffer` unless noted.

| Configuration | Tree | Kept turns: state ahead / behind / equal | Released | Turn-2 greedy mismatches | First-token gap, median / max |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Length, NGRAM, overlap (default) | main | 20 / 3 / 1 | 0 | 6 of 12 | 0.2010 / 0.4665 |
| | this PR | 0 / 0 / 3 | 21 | 0 of 12 | 0.0000 / 0.0002 |
| Length, NGRAM, no overlap | main | 6 / 9 / 9 | 0 | 4 of 12 | 0.0127 / 0.4665 |
| | this PR | 0 / 0 / 18 | 6 | 1 of 12 | 0.0001 / 0.0099 |
| Length, NGRAM, no overlap, `no_buffer` | main | 6 / 9 / 9 | 0 | 5 of 12 | 0.0394 / 0.4207 |
| | this PR | 0 / 0 / 18 | 6 | 2 of 12 | 0.0003 / 0.0477 |
| Stop token, NGRAM, overlap | main | 23 / 1 / 0 | 0 | 6 of 12 | 0.1016 / 0.2403 |
| | this PR | 0 / 0 / 1 | 23 | 0 of 12 | 0.0000 / 0.0017 |
| Stop token, no speculation, overlap | main | 12 / 0 / 12 | 0 | 0 of 12 | 0.0451 / 0.0472 |
| | this PR | 0 / 0 / 12 | 12 | 0 of 12 | 0.0000 / 0.0017 |
| Length, no speculation, overlap (control) | both | 0 / 0 / 24 | 0 | 4 of 12 | 0.0015 / 0.0597 |

The remaining mismatches with this PR are all on passage prompts, where the no-speculation control also differs from the fresh request.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Only released turns cost extra: the next turn re-prefills the tokens after the last Mamba checkpoint. Batches keep planning overlap.

Throughput: 8 sequential sessions of 6 turns, overlap on, on an RTX A6000 with no other jobs. Main and this PR were launched alternately, three times each for 12-token turns and twice each for 64-token turns, with two repeats per launch.

| Workload | main (tok/s) | this PR (tok/s) | Diff | Cached tokens, main / this PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 12 output tokens per turn, NGRAM 4 | 390.4 (382.2 to 399.3) | 388.7 (377.2 to 397.3) | -0.4% | 5,280 / 3,584 to 5,120 |
| 64 output tokens per turn, NGRAM 4 | 676.5 (673.9 to 679.5) | 635.5 (634.8 to 636.0) | -6.1% | 11,520 / 8,704 to 9,728 |
| 12 output tokens per turn, no speculation | 245.0 (244.5 to 245.4) | 245.6 (244.5 to 246.6) | +0.2% | 5,240 / 5,240 |

Under overlap most speculative turns are released (21 of 24 in the length replay above), and the lower cached-token count shows the re-prefill.

+"""The overlap loop marks a request whose result it processes when a launched or
+planned batch already runs the request again; a streaming session then releases
+the turn's recurrent state instead of keeping state the rerun advances."""
+
+import unittest
+from array import array
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req, ScheduleBatch
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _make_req() -> Req:
+    sampling_params = SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=8)
+    sampling_params.normalize(None)
+    return Req(
+        rid="r",
+        origin_input_text="",
+        origin_input_ids=array("q", [1, 2, 3]),
+        sampling_params=sampling_params,
+        vocab_size=128,
+    )

+def _marks_at_processing(*, replan=True, sync=False, hybrid=True, sessions=True):
+    """Run two overlap-loop iterations of one request and return the request's
+    mark each time a result of it is processed."""
+    req = _make_req()
+    marks = []
+
+    def make_batch(reqs):
+        return ScheduleBatch(
+            reqs=reqs,
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            spec_algorithm=SpeculativeAlgorithm.NGRAM,
+        )
+
+    plans = iter([make_batch([req]), make_batch([req]) if replan else None])
+    scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+    scheduler.gracefully_exit = False
+    scheduler.ingest_requests = MagicMock(side_effect=[[], [], StopIteration])
+    scheduler._engine_paused = False
+    scheduler.enable_unified_memory = False
+    scheduler.is_generation = False
+    scheduler.is_hybrid_ssm = hybrid
+    scheduler.running_batch = make_batch([req])
+    scheduler.last_batch = None
+    scheduler._apply_war_barrier = MagicMock()
+    scheduler.on_idle = MagicMock()
+    scheduler.get_next_batch_to_run = lambda *, running_batch, last_batch: MagicMock(
+        running_batch=running_batch, batch_to_run=next(plans)
+    )
+    scheduler.is_disable_overlap_for_batch = lambda batch, last_batch: (
+        sync and last_batch is not None
+    )
+    scheduler.run_batch = lambda batch: object()
+    scheduler.process_batch_result = lambda batch, result: marks.append(
+        req.relaunched_in_flight
+    )
+
+    with get_context().override_server_args(enable_streaming_session=sessions):
+        with unittest.TestCase().assertRaises(StopIteration):
+            scheduler.event_loop_overlap()
+    return marks

+    def test_request_rerun_before_its_result_is_marked(self):

+    def test_request_not_rerun_is_not_marked(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_marks_at_processing(replan=False), [False])

+    def test_marking_needs_recurrent_state_and_streaming_sessions(self):
+        for case in (dict(hybrid=False), dict(sessions=False)):

+    accepted run committed ``committed`` and emitted ``overshoot`` tokens past

+    req.session.finish_req = finished.append
